item.title: D-Day VR Museum On Steam Is An Entertaining Educational Exhibition
item.description: D-Day VR Museum is a PC VR exhibition of one of the most pivotal moments in history, using every audiovisual tool to keep the education engaging.

item.title: Quest 3 v85 PTC Can Turn Any Surface Into A Virtual Keyboard
item.description: With Horizon OS v85 PTC, Quest 3 can turn any surface into a virtual keyboard and touchpad, and Meta says you can remap the Quest 3S action button.

item.title: Orcs Must Die: By The Blade Gets Delayed Release Date
item.description: Orcs Must Die: By The Blade will now release on February 12, after a brief delay in late January.

item.title: Meta & University Of Utah Explore Using Neural Band For Accessibility
item.description: The Utah NeuroRobotics Lab is exploring Meta's Neural Band as an accessibility tool instead of relying on chin joysticks, head switches, and sip-and-puff controls.

item.title: Evangelion: Δ Cross Reflections To Be Shown Later This Month
item.description: Developer Pixelity confirmed that Evangelion: Δ Cross Reflections will be shown at the franchise's 30th anniversary event this month.

item.title: UG's Investors Commit $2M In Funding For New VR Games
item.description: Investors of top-grossing Quest title UG have committed $2 million in funding for new social-first VR games.

item.title: GOLF+ Roadmap Reveal Includes Planned PC VR Port
item.description: The best-selling golf game on Quest is expanding in 2026, with new features, new courses, and a port to PC VR.

item.title: Aces of Thunder Review: A Visceral & Thrilling VR Combat Flight Sim
item.description: Aces of Thunder, available on Steam and PlayStation VR2, is a thrilling callback to the classic combat flight sims of yesteryear.

item.title: Catana: Red Flowers - Hands-On With A Feisty Feline
item.description: Catana: Red Flowers is a violent, fast-paced action game combined with a low-stakes restaurant management sandbox.

item.title: Fanmade Port of Nintendo 64 Classic Perfect Dark Running On Quest
item.description: A fanmade port of Nintendo 64 classic Perfect Dark is coming to Quest.
